why: A 2025-2026 preprint (arXiv:2609.02882) claims an unconditional proof that more than 67.25% of nontrivial zeta zeros are simple and on the critical line (and 83.62% distinct), which would improve the known proportion of zeros on the critical line — the problem's own tracked quantity. Numerous other 2024-2026 preprints claim full proofs or disproofs of RH but show no signs of community acceptance.
